channel.title: Writing by Mohamed Talaye
channel.description: Articles by Mohamed Talaye on invisible OSS, AI-native operations, B2B connectivity and technology leadership.

item.title: Invisible OSS: From Operational Support to AI-Native Network Intelligence
item.description: Invisible OSS does not mean OSS disappears. It means the complexity of operations disappears from the customer experience, because intelligence, automation and control move inside the network.

item.title: From CTO to Chief Visionary Officer: How AI May Redefine Technology Leadership
item.description: As AI agents take on more of architecture, development and execution, technology leadership may shift from supervising delivery to shaping vision, structured intent and trust. A personal reflection on the AIshore era.

item.title: B2B Connectivity in the AI Era: The Future Is Not Just More Bandwidth
item.description: AI changes the nature of enterprise traffic, not only its volume. The future of B2B connectivity is connectivity plus intelligence, plus control, plus trust, delivered as a platform.

item.title: AI and blast radius: change the control system, not the scope
item.description: A response to Philippe Ensarguet on AI-written code in mission-critical systems. The risk is not AI generating code. The risk is AI generating code without fast, intelligent feedback loops.
